subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

b _ d _ p b c _ p _ _ c _ p p b _ _ p p
solution:
Given series: b _ d _ p b c _ p _ _ c _ p p b _ _ p p 

Option 1) cpdpdbdc → b __c__ d __p__ p b c __d__ p __p__ __d__ c __b__ p p b __d__ __c__ p p → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) cpdpbdcd → b __**c**__ d __**p**__ p b c __**d**__ p __**p**__ __**b**__ c __**d**__ p p b __**c**__ __**d**__ p p → (It follows the pattern of: bcdpp - bcdpp - bcdpp - bcdpp)

Option 3) cdppbddc → b __c__ d __d__ p b c __p__ p __p__ __b__ c __d__ p p b __d__ __c__ p p → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) pcdpbdcd → b __p__ d __c__ p b c __d__ p __p__ __b__ c __d__ p p b __c__ __d__ p p → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
